Újpest (4. kerület) — Budapest, Hungary

Average day Average night

In detail

A dense, mixed residential-industrial district on the northern Pest side. No single dramatic incident or hotspot ranking was found for Újpest in this research, but district-council crime reports and recurring police bulletins about drug offences ("kábítószer") in the area point to an ongoing, unremarkable-but-real level of drug-related enforcement activity, rather than either a standout safe or standout dangerous profile. Rated with the caution this mixed picture warrants rather than assumed either way. Sources checked: Ujpest.hu district council public-safety committee reports, 2024-2026 (recurring drug-enforcement items).
